verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Collection Runner and unlimited collection runs let users execute many requests/tests in bulk, and the Inso CLI automates this across CI pipelines, giving solid bulk-execution support (insomnia-docs-4, insomnia-docs-20, insomnia-docs-39, insomnia-docs-53, insomnia-docs-55). However, evidence is limited to running/testing many requests together—there's no documented bulk editing, bulk tagging, or bulk deletion of items, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific bulk workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of bulk editing/management of many items beyond execution, and independent corroboration of the Collection Runner/Inso CLI bulk workflow.
